title: Independent Qualification of Transaction-Composed Richards Temporal Indicator History
scope: independent production/composition qualification only; no scientific tolerance or production temporal acceptance

independent_disjoint_composition_matrix.role: independent composition-equivalence matrix; not a scientific truth/error-bound matrix
independent_disjoint_composition_matrix.previous_derivative_rule: compute the same stationary-prejump right derivative independently from the admitted B1.10 constitutive state and prescribed bottom-head jump, then supply exactly that vector to both comparison routes
independent_disjoint_composition_matrix.direct_route: reference Richards solve plus direct F-SI25 evaluate_temporal_indicator with explicit previous derivative
independent_disjoint_composition_matrix.transaction_route: same physical problem initialized with F-KT10 committed-state history seed and evaluated through the production transaction/runtime composition
independent_disjoint_composition_matrix.comparison_rule: direct and transaction routes must agree in B_inf and current derivative to strict deterministic floating-regression tolerance, while principal physical state/flux/mass and bounded-cost semantics remain unchanged

mandatory_regression_matrix.purpose: prove no regression relative to independently qualified pre-production indicator transfer
mandatory_regression_matrix.required_result: transaction-supplied history reproduces frozen production B_inf values with hard mass and bounded-cost shape unchanged

gates.G01_SOURCE_LINEAGE_LOCK: All source-lock blobs and owner decisions match this frozen plan.
gates.G02_TRANSACTION_LIFECYCLE: Independently replay warmup, accepted commit, temporal rejection, solver rejection, mass rejection, retry, rollback and committed-history reuse; rejected paths never mutate committed history.
gates.G03_FEATURE_SCOPE_AND_A_B_A: Inactive layouts have no derivative vector; A-B-A column execution has no history leakage.
gates.G04_REAL_PRODUCTION_BINDING: Reference Richards production seam uses transaction-owned history without changing physical state, accepted fluxes, mass accounting or principal solve status.
gates.G05_FROZEN_F_VQ30_REPLAY: All 16 frozen F-VQ30 production cases reproduce their frozen B_inf using transaction-supplied history with hard mass and bounded cost unchanged.
gates.G06_DISJOINT_COMPOSITION_MATRIX: All 12 frozen independent cases produce finite direct and transaction indicators and match each other under frozen comparison rules.
gates.G07_BOUNDED_COST: Normal indicator path adds zero full nonlinear trajectories and at most one defect tridiagonal solve.
gates.G08_HARD_MASS_NONINTERFERENCE: Hard 1e-12 mass gate passes and continuation plumbing does not alter physical state or accepted fluxes.
gates.G09_O0_O2: Focused machine-readable qualification output is bitwise identical under O0/O2 current convention.
gates.G10_POLICY_FAIL_CLOSED: B_inf is never promoted into F-KT09 dimensionless certificate; production temporal acceptance remains unavailable/fail-closed.
gates.G11_SEED_CONTINUITY_BOUNDARY: No-seed warmup remains unavailable; invalid seed fails closed; arbitrary restart and forcing/event discontinuity continuity are not admitted.

pass_rules: No production candidate formula, physical fixture semantics, mass gate or F-KT09 certificate contract is changed after execution.
All 12 independent composition cases are retained regardless of outcome.
All 16 frozen F-VQ30 regression cases are retained regardless of outcome.
No empirical rescue factor, normalization or tolerance is introduced.
Any source-lock, finite-output, lifecycle, noninterference, hard-mass, cost or O0/O2 failure prevents PASS.
hard_nonclaims: B_inf is not a qualified general nonlinear true-error upper bound.
No scientific temporal normalization or application tolerance is selected.
No production temporal acceptance or retry policy is admitted.
No arbitrary restart-file persistence is qualified.
No q_cap, Nmin, geometric-tail multiplier, fitted safety factor or deep production refinement trajectory is introduced.
F-GC02, groundwater coupling and F-PE remain unreleased.
next_action: After this plan commit, implement VQ-owned source guards and independent direct-vs-transaction composition harness, then execute exactly the frozen 12-case matrix plus mandatory frozen F-VQ30 regression.
